subject: m2 dos not work for missing data

messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: m2 dos not work for missing data
parts:
Hi Phil

I run my analysis by 'mirt'. my analysis is the effect of different treatments with missing data (miss=wrong or NA) on item and person parameters and then run M2 for model fitting but result to an Error. any help 

mod <- mirt(dat, 1)
M2(mod)
Error: Fit statistics cannot be computed when there are missing data. Pass a suitable
                 impute argument to compute statistics following multiple
                 data imputations

messages.author: 5bf08cf571cc1b1a
messages.subject: Re: m2 dos not work for missing data
parts:
Hi,

I have the issue above you, which is also a problem with M2() and I have been palying around with it for a while, and may be able to help.  You need to pass an argument to impute datasets from the model if you have missing data.

So, try:

mod <- mirt(dat, 1)
M2(mod, impute = 10)

Hopefully that helps.

Best,

Gareth.

messages.author: 5bf08cf571cc1b1a
messages.subject: Re: m2 dos not work for missing data
parts:
Hi,

Oh, I see.  M2 won't run with missing data. I think you are going to have to impute.

Imputing shouldn't be a problem for your analysis as, as I understand it.  So you want to extract fit statistics of two models one in which you have replaced non-responses with NAs and another in which you have replaced non-responses with 0s.  You are imputing after the models have been fitted, based on the models, so I can't see as it is a problem.  The extracted fit statistics should still be pertinant to the model based on that "traeatment" (i.e., 0 or NA) of missing values.

That is my 2 cents anyway.

Best,

Gaeth.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: m2 dos not work for missing data
parts:
On the dev version it's possible to pass an na.rm=TRUE argument to remove cases row-wise, so that may solve the problem both conceptually and theoretically. Enough people complained about this that I thought supporting row-wise deletion in many of mirt's functions was reasonable (e.g.., itemfit(), M2(), SIBTEST()...). https://github.com/philchalmers/mirt/blob/master/NEWS.md 

Feel free to install from Github, otherwise just wait till the next major release. 

Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: m2 dos not work for missing data
parts:
Technically, yes. But if you remove the data beforehand then your parameter estimates will be affected. Hence, why these secondary functions now support the removal of data after the model has been estimated.

Phil
